transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net customer technical support. My name is Marcus. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Marcus. I am calling in absolute desperation about our catastrophic broadband outage here in Harrogate. Our entire street has had zero broadband connectivity for four consecutive days, ever since a water main burst on Wednesday morning. My S-Net router shows a solid red optical alarm light and we have had zero communication or updates!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can certainly look into that ongoing area broadband outage for you, Valerie. Before we inspect the exchange incident logs, may I please verify your billing address and your security question answer?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it is 19 Duchy Road, Harrogate, HG1 2ER. And my security question answer is my mother's maiden name, Henderson.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you Valerie, that verifies the account record. What is your landline telephone number?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The phone number is 01423 496 0881. Marcus, I am a senior clinical psychologist providing remote NHS emergency psychiatric consultations from my home clinic! Over the last four days, I have had to cancel thirty-two vulnerable patients in severe psychological distress because S-Net has failed to restore our broadband! Two of my patients had acute suicidal crises over the weekend and their crisis team could not reach me because our digital VoIP phone line is completely dead! Lives are genuinely on the line, and every time I phone S-Net I get told another vague excuse! This is completely disgraceful and unacceptable!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Network engineering records indicate a catastrophic tier-one civil fiber sever incident affecting six hundred premises across the Harrogate exchange area.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Marcus, please stop reading scripted engineering press releases! I need to know when my clinical line will actually be reconnected!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: So to ensure I have the full picture, your home clinic has been completely offline for four days due to the major water main fiber sever, disabling both your broadband connection and emergency patient VoIP telephone lines, and you require definitive restoration timeframes and priority escalation. Is that correct, Valerie?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, that is exactly what is happening and why this situation is an absolute emergency.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Can you check the small Openreach optical network terminal mounted on your wall, Valerie? Is the PON light completely unlit or flashing red?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The LOS red alarm light is flashing rapidly and the green PON light is completely off.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Flashing red LOS confirms zero optical carrier light is reaching the optical receiver from the local distribution cabinet.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: When are the engineers going to fix the severed cable?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Civil engineering contractors and water utility crews handle underground excavations; customer service agents do not operate backhoes or dig trenches and have zero control over municipal repair teams.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I did not hire the water board! S-Net is my communications provider and you have a duty of care to provide updates and resolution!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Do you have an S-Net 4G hybrid backup dongle plugged into the USB port of your broadband Hub, Valerie?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, I was never supplied with a hybrid 4G backup dongle when my fiber package was installed.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The major incident ticket shows Yorkshire Water completed pumping out the flooded cable duct at midnight last night.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: If the water was pumped out at midnight, why haven't the optical fibers been re-spliced yet? Why is it taking another full day?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Will you just shut up and let me explain the restoration process! Continuous complaining does not make the glass fibers fuse any faster!

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Did you seriously just tell me to shut up?! How dare you! I am an NHS medical professional dealing with a life-threatening patient crisis and you tell me to shut up?! That is the most outrageous, abusive misconduct I have ever experienced from any company! I want your manager right now!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I apologize, Valerie, that remark was uncalled for. I am reading the engineering status report directly from Openreach major incident command.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: You will be formally reported to Ofcom and senior management for that verbal abuse! Tell me the exact repair ETA on that screen!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Openreach specialized fiber fusion teams have pulled two new ninety-six-core ribbon cables through the cleared subterranean duct.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How many fibers have been spliced together so far?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Seventy-four of the ninety-six individual glass fibers have been fusion spliced and sealed in the waterproof joint enclosure.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What is the estimated completion time for the remaining optical joints?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The fiber fusion team projects final splice enclosure sealing by three o'clock this afternoon.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: So the physical optical connection should be restored by three PM today?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Once the physical enclosure is sealed, the optical line terminal in the Harrogate exchange will broadcast light to reboot the local ONTs.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Will my ONT automatically pick up the signal or do I need to power-cycle it at three PM?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously power-cycling the optical unit forces immediate laser resynchronization without waiting for the twenty-minute network polling sweep, Valerie.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will turn off the ONT mains switch at three PM and turn it back on.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have also escalated your account under Major Incident Ticket INC-882014 with priority health service marker.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What does the priority health service marker do on that incident ticket?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The health service marker triggers automated line testing as soon as exchange light levels return, notifying engineering supervisors immediately.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That gives some reassurance that our line will be verified promptly.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us also arrange immediate emergency mobile data provision so you can conduct patient video calls via mobile hotspot this afternoon.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, I have an NHS laptop that can tether to my smartphone if I have sufficient mobile data.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have added an unlimited one-hundred-gigabyte emergency mobile data boost to your account phone number.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The data boost confirmation text just landed on my phone. That will allow me to hold my two o'clock patient session.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us check the statutory automatic compensation payout due for the four days of total broadband service outage.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Under the Ofcom automatic compensation code, how much is S-Net crediting back to our account?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Under statutory Ofcom rules, you receive nine pounds and seventy-six pence per day for every day of delayed repair beyond day two, totaling thirty-nine pounds and four pence.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That statutory credit is fair and should be credited immediately.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have posted a credit of thirty-nine pounds and four pence directly to your subscriber billing ledger.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you for processing that credit.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us verify your mobile phone number for automated SMS notifications when the exchange fiber light is restored, Valerie.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: My mobile phone number is 07700 900812.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have enrolled 07700 900812 for instant major incident resolution alerts.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will keep my mobile nearby.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let us also order a permanent S-Net Hybrid 4G Connect dongle for your Hub to prevent future outage disruptions.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, please dispatch that hybrid backup dongle so if fiber lines are cut again, our medical practice automatically switches to cellular.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have ordered an S-Net Hybrid Connect backup dongle under hardware dispatch docket DISP-883901.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I have noted docket DISP-883901 in my diary.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The hybrid unit will arrive by tracked courier by tomorrow midday.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That will give us peace of mind for future clinic operations.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just to reconfirm, the major fiber incident ticket is INC-882014 with full restoration expected by fifteen hundred hours today.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, ticket INC-882014 with three PM resolution. That is clear.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am pleased we have verified the fiber repair timeline, provisioned mobile data tethering, and applied statutory outage credits. Have I answered all of your questions and completely resolved your support query today, Valerie?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes Marcus, you have answered my technical questions regarding the outage, though I am still reporting your earlier remark. Thank you for the update.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net. Have a good afternoon. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye Marcus, have a good day.
